name: Ability Draft
tagline: Draft a hero, then draft their abilities from everyone else. Play a full match with the kit you built.
summary: Twelve seats take turns picking from a board of 18 heroes and their abilities. Then the teams play a normal Deadlock match with their mixed kits.
description: Ability Draft by sh3lk brings the classic draft format to Deadlock. Join a team in the lobby and let bots fill the empty seats. The draft board shows 18 heroes. Each seat picks a body and then one ability for each key, ten seconds a pick, so your ultimate might come from one hero and your first ability from another. Then both teams play a regular match on Midtown with the kits they built. The corrupted item shop from the Broker returns too: the lobby chooses when it opens, and it restocks every 15 minutes.

howToPlay.title: Pick a side
howToPlay.body: Choose the Hidden King or the Archmother in the lobby. Bots take any seat nobody claims.

howToPlay.title: Draft your kit
howToPlay.body: Take turns picking from the board: a hero to play and one ability for each key. Each pick has ten seconds.

howToPlay.title: Play the match
howToPlay.body: Both teams play a normal match with the kits they drafted. Watch for the Broker's corrupted shop.

facts.label: Broker
facts.value: Opens at 15 or 30 min, or never
